description.value: Imran Beef Noodle is a halal Chinese restaurant on Vancouver's busy Robson Street specializing in Lanzhou-style hand-pulled beef noodles, as indicated by the Chinese name 伊穆兰·兰州牛肉面. It is a sit-down restaurant with indoor seating and wheelchair-accessible entry, making it a practical stop for cyclists looking for a filling halal meal in the West End.
